additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437112-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Short charging sessions CRM:02889000196
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes Dissauer,
Greetings of the day!
We have investigated the reported timestamps and found that the charger was running on the older firmware version 6.1.3 at that time. To resolve the issue, our colleague has updated the charger to the latest firmware version 7.0.5. Since then, the charger has been functioning properly. We have also reviewed recent charging sessions and confirmed that the charger is working fine.
May we proceed with closing the ticket?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0437112-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S5 170003620] Short charging sessions CRM:02889000196
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes Dissauer,
Certainly, we always obtain permission from the customer (ticket creator) before proceeding with any firmware updates. In this case, we received approval from the end customer, Mr. Cenoiu Catalin George, in the previous ticket (ID0434059), which was created by him.
Regarding the 0kW charging session, the issue appears to have been related to firmware version 6.1.3. Our colleague Francois Winckel obtained the necessary permission from the customer and proceeded to update the charger to firmware version 7.0.5.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or if we may proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
